source: Captured from AIM 5.1.3036 on 2026-11-12, on Get File links through a server relay. Each header has 256 bytes. The shared folder held generated files with neutral names. A note says which vectors AIM wrote and which a test client wrote. AIM answered or accepted each vector of the test client.

vectors.name: 5.1 listing header
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. It holds the count of the files, the sum of their sizes, and the length and the checksum of the listing. Byte 101 is the column of the name in a line and byte 102 is the column of the size.

vectors.name: 5.1 listing
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The whole listing of a folder of 207 generated files: the size from column 16, the name from column 26, the folders of a name divided by a backslash.

vectors.name: listing acknowledge that 5.1 took
vectors.note: A test client wrote this, and AIM 5.1.3036 sent the listing after it. It is the 5.1 listing header with a different type.

vectors.name: listing done that 5.1 took
vectors.note: A test client wrote this, and AIM 5.1.3036 kept the link open after it. It is the 5.1 listing header with a different type, the count and the checksum of the bytes that came, and bit 0 of the flags set.

vectors.name: 5.1 prompt
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The answer to a request for a.txt: a file of 1024 bytes, one file in the count.

vectors.name: 5.1 prompt, a path
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The answer to a request for a file in a folder. Byte 0x01 divides the folders.

vectors.name: ack that 5.1 took
vectors.note: A test client wrote this, and AIM 5.1.3036 sent the file after it. It is the 5.1 prompt with a different type.

vectors.name: done that 5.1 took
vectors.note: A test client wrote this, and AIM 5.1.3036 answered the next request after it. It is the 5.1 prompt with a different type, the count and the checksum of the bytes that came, and bit 0 of the flags set.

vectors.name: listing header that 5.1 answered
vectors.note: A test client wrote this, and AIM 5.1.3036 showed the 207 files. The size is from column 17 and the name is from column 28, as bytes 102 and 101 say.

vectors.name: listing that 5.1 read
vectors.note: A test client wrote this, and AIM 5.1.3036 showed each name whole. The same files as the 5.1 listing, with the size from column 17 and the name from column 28.

vectors.name: 5.1 listing acknowledge
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The answer to the header before. It is that header with a different type, the id text of AIM, and zero in the two checksums of the resource fork.

vectors.name: 5.1 listing done
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The answer after the bytes of the listing: their count, their checksum, and bit 0 of the flags set.

vectors.name: 5.1 request, a name at the top
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The request for a.txt, made from the 5.1 listing done. The two sizes are zero. The name ends at the zero byte, and the bytes after it are from the name before.

vectors.name: prompt that 5.1 answered
vectors.note: A test client wrote this, and AIM 5.1.3036 took the file of 1024 bytes.

vectors.name: 5.1 ack
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The answer to the prompt before.

vectors.name: 5.1 done
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The answer after the 1024 bytes: their count, their checksum, and bit 0 of the flags set.

vectors.name: 5.1 request, a path
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The request for a file in a folder, made from the 5.1 done. Byte 0x01 divides the folders.

vectors.name: 5.1 ack, a path
vectors.note: AIM 5.1.3036 wrote this. The answer to a prompt with the name sub, byte 0x01, c.txt. AIM writes a backslash in the place of byte 0x01.

vectors.name: 5.1 refusal
vectors.note: The body of the client error (family 0x04, subtype 0x0B) that AIM 5.1.3036 sends when its user does not approve, and when it allows no one. Cookie, channel 2, an 11-character screen name, code 3, then 0002 0002. The screen name is replaced with one of the same length.
